header.userPrompt:
Create a `document` at bank-statement UPLOAD and link the draft to it — make statement ingestion
consistent with receipts. This is a STRUCTURAL refactor only: no change to extraction, review, or
confirm OUTCOMES, only to WHEN/HOW the document row is created.

BACKGROUND: today a bank-statement upload creates ONLY a `bank_statement_draft` (with its own
sha256/storage_key/filename and NO document_id); the `document` row (kind=BankStatementPdf) is created
LATER, at CONFIRM (ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction). Receipts, by contrast, already create a `document`
at upload (ReceiptRepository.createWithDocument) with a receipt stub linked by document_id. This makes
statements the odd path. Fix: every statement upload creates a `document` up front, and the draft links
to it.

SCOPE:
1. Evolution (Ups only; next number after the current highest on main — main currently goes up to 6.sql,
   so this is `7.sql`; follow repo evolution conventions, NO CHECK constraints): add a `document_id UUID`
   column to `bank_statement_draft` with a FOREIGN KEY to `document(id)`. The table is EMPTY in prod, so
   NOT NULL is acceptable with no backfill; only fall back to nullable if existing dev/test rows make NOT
   NULL unsafe.
2. CreateBankStatementDraftAction (upload): in ONE transaction, create a `document` row
   (kind = DocumentKind.BankStatementPdf, status = DocumentStatus.Ingested) holding the file
   (sha256, storage_key, filename), AND create the draft with its `document_id` pointing at that document.
   Preserve the existing dedup: if a document with the same (user_id, sha256) already exists
   (documentsRepository.findBySha256), reuse/link it instead of creating a duplicate — keep today's dedup
   behavior. The draft MAY keep its own sha256/storage_key/filename for now (the extraction job reads
   storage_key from the draft); do NOT remove those draft columns in this PR — fully moving file fields
   onto `document` is a separate follow-up.
3. ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction (confirm): it currently CREATES the document (BankStatementPdf, Parsed).
   Change it to NOT create a new document — the document already exists from upload. Instead look it up via
   the draft's document_id and UPDATE that document's status to Parsed (documentsRepository.updateStatus),
   leaving the rest of confirm (creating the bank_statement / expenses / linking) unchanged.
4. Model/DAO: add `document_id` to the BankStatementDraft model, its Create, and BankStatementDraftDAO
   (insert + select + the Anorm parser). Use Chimney for case-class mapping where applicable.
5. Routing stays as-is: ProcessDocumentAction already SKIPS DocumentKind.BankStatementPdf, so the new
   statement `document` must NOT enqueue ProcessDocument/Textract — only the existing draft-extraction job
   runs for statements. Keep that guard.

EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE (do NOT touch):
- The AI classifier / `ai_*` columns / any classification logic — that is a different, in-flight PR. Do not
  add, read, or move those columns.
- The receipt-status / `document.status` / `parser_version` cleanup (a later PR).
- Moving the file fields off the draft; any web/frontend change.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Follow docs/guide (antipatterns, backend, data-infra, testing, ci-checklist) and CLAUDE.md.
- User-scoped DB access (WHERE user_id = ?); stable ORDER BY; no CHECK constraints; Chimney for mapping;
  enums over stringly-typed values; never drop a Future; wrap the upload (document+draft) and the confirm
  update each in ONE transaction; log the work with the userId after the user is resolved.
- No dependency changes (build.sbt/plugins.sbt/package.json); revert incidental yarn.lock churn.
- Evolution Ups-only.
- Attribution: NO Claude session links (claude.ai/ or Claude-Session) in commits or the PR description;
  `Co-Authored-By: Claude` IS allowed.

TESTS:
- CreateBankStatementDraftAction creates a document (BankStatementPdf, Ingested) AND a draft linked by
  document_id in one transaction; a second upload of the same (user, sha256) reuses the existing document
  (no duplicate) and still dedups the draft as today.
- ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction updates the existing document to Parsed and does NOT create a second
  document; the statement/expense creation behavior is unchanged.
- BankStatementDraft repository/DAO round-trips document_id.
- ProcessDocument still skips a BankStatementPdf document (no Textract enqueued).
- Verify per task with targeted `sbt "testOnly *Spec"` or `CI=true sbt Test/compile`; the final stage runs
  the full suite.

resultJson.description:
Make bank-statement ingestion follow the same shape as receipts: the `document` row (kind=BankStatementPdf) is created when the statement is uploaded, not when the draft is confirmed. Today `CreateBankStatementDraftAction` only inserts a `bank_statement_draft` (which carries its own sha256/storage_key/filename and no document link), and `ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction` creates the `document` (status Parsed) in the same transaction as the `bank_statement` and its rows. Receipts instead create `document` + receipt stub together at upload (`ReceiptRepository.createWithDocument`). After this epic, every statement upload creates (or, on dedup, reuses) a `document` with status Ingested in the same transaction as the draft. The draft points to it through a new NOT NULL `bank_statement_draft.document_id` FK. Confirm then sets that existing document to Parsed, in the same transaction as the statement/rows/suggestions job, and does not insert a second document.

This is a structural refactor only. Extraction (the ExtractBankStatementDraft job still reads `storage_key` from the draft), review, and confirm outcomes stay the same: the same statement, rows, extraction info, suggestions job and error messages. The draft keeps its own sha256/storage_key/filename columns; moving them onto `document` is a later PR. The new statement document must not enter the Textract pipeline. Upload inserts the document through `DocumentDAO.create` directly, without enqueuing a `ProcessDocument` job, and `ProcessDocumentAction` keeps its `DocumentKind.BankStatementPdf` skip. Out of scope: AI classifier / `ai_*` columns, document.status/parser_version cleanup, removing draft file columns, and any web/frontend change.

Dedup must stay as it is today. A draft with the same sha256 → "This file is already in your import queue". An existing document with a confirmed `bank_statement` → "This statement was already imported". An existing document with no statement (the normal case after a discarded draft, since the document now outlives the draft) → reuse that document id for the new draft and insert no new document, because `document` has UNIQUE (user_id, sha256). Recommended guard: reuse only when the existing document's kind is BankStatementPdf; otherwise fail loudly with a clear message. Today that case would already fail at confirm on the unique constraint, so this only moves the failure earlier.

tasks.title: Evolution 7.sql + draft document_id plumbing + create document at upload
tasks.description:
Must ship as one unit, because the NOT NULL column breaks every draft insert until the model, DAO and upload all supply document_id.

1. Add `server/src/main/resources/evolutions/default/7.sql` (Ups-only, no CHECK, no DEFAULT):
   - `ALTER TABLE bank_statement_draft ADD COLUMN document_id UUID NOT NULL;`
   - FK constraint (named per the data-infra.md pattern, e.g. `bank_statement_draft_document_fk`) REFERENCES document(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, matching receipt/bank_statement → document.
   - `CREATE INDEX bank_statement_draft_document_id_index ON bank_statement_draft USING BTREE (document_id);`
   - A short comment explaining the column.
   - NOT NULL is OK: prod table is empty and test DBs are fresh. Mention in the PR that local dev DBs with leftover drafts must discard them first.
2. Model `repositories/models/BankStatementDraft.scala`: add `documentId: UUID` to the case class and to `Create`.
3. `BankStatementDraftDAO`: add `document_id` to `selectColumns`, the hand-written `parser` (`get[UUID]("document_id")`), and the INSERT.
4. `BankStatementDraftRepository.create`: take an optional new document, e.g. `create(document: Option[Document.Create], draft: BankStatementDraft.Create, job: BackgroundJobData.Create)`. In ONE `withTransaction`: `document.foreach(DocumentDAO.create)`, then `BankStatementDraftDAO.create(draft)`, then `BackgroundJobDAO.create(job)`. Do NOT use `DocumentsRepository.create`, which enqueues a ProcessDocument job.
5. `CreateBankStatementDraftAction`:
   - Keep the existing draft-dedup and already-imported checks.
   - If `existingDoc` is Some (and kind == BankStatementPdf; otherwise throw a clear RuntimeException), reuse `doc.id` and pass `None`.
   - Else build `Document.Create(id = UuidCreator.getTimeOrderedEpoch(), userId, sha256, storageKey, kind = DocumentKind.BankStatementPdf, filename, status = DocumentStatus.Ingested, createdAt = now, updatedAt = now)` and pass `Some(doc)`.
   - Build the draft Create with `documentId`. Use Chimney (`docCreate.into[DraftRecord.Create].withFieldConst(_.id, draftId).withFieldConst(_.documentId, ...).transform`) where it fits.
   - Update the log line to include userId and documentId.
6. Tests:
   - Add `bankStatementDrafts: BankStatementDraftRepository` to `server/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/core/RepositoryComponents.scala` and wire it in `RepositorySpec.withRepositories`.
   - Optionally add a `createBankStatementDraft` helper in `utils/RepositoryUtils.scala`.
   - New `server/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/repositories/BankStatementDraftRepositorySpec.scala`: create with Some(doc) round-trips documentId via findByIdForUser/listByUser/findById and the document exists with kind BankStatementPdf, status Ingested. Create with None links to a pre-existing document (`createDocument(..., kind = BankStatementPdf)`) and adds no second document.
   - `controllers/BankStatementDraftControllerSpec.scala`:
     - Fix `seedReadyDraftJson` to insert a BankStatementPdf document first (DocumentDAO.create in the same db connection) and pass its id.
     - Upload creates exactly one document for the user (kind BankStatementPdf, status Ingested) and the draft's document_id points to it; inspect via the Database/DAOs, as the existing job-count test does.
     - Upload enqueues no ProcessDocument job for that document.
     - Uploading the same bytes twice still fails with "already" and leaves one document.
     - Upload → discard → re-upload of the same bytes succeeds, reuses the same document id, and leaves one document.
7. Verify: `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, then `sbt "testOnly *BankStatementDraftRepositorySpec *BankStatementDraftControllerSpec"`.

tasks.title: Confirm updates the existing document to Parsed instead of creating one
tasks.description:
1. `BankStatementRepository.createConfirmedStatement`:
   - Drop the `document: Document.Create` parameter. New signature: `createConfirmedStatement(stmt, metadata, rows, extractionInfo, job)`.
   - Inside the same `withTransaction`, call `DocumentDAO.updateStatus(stmt.documentId, DocumentStatus.Parsed, parserVersion = None, updatedAt = stmt.updatedAt)` instead of `DocumentDAO.create`, then the existing statement/rows/job inserts.
   - The repository has no Clock, so use `stmt.updatedAt`.
   - updateStatus already throws if the document is missing.
2. `ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction`:
   - Inject `DocumentsRepository`.
   - After loading the draft, look up the document with the user-scoped `documentsRepository.find(draft.documentId, userId)` and fail with a clear RuntimeException if it is absent.
   - Build `BankStatement.Create(stmtId, draft.documentId, userId, ...)`.
   - Remove the `Document.Create` construction and the now-unused imports (`Document`, `DocumentKind`, `DocumentStatus` if unused). Keep reconciliation, metadata checks, rows, extractionInfo, suggestions job, draft delete and the log line unchanged; add userId to the log.
3. Update test callers:
   - `controllers/common/PlayPostgresSpec.createBankStatementWithRows`: insert the BankStatementPdf document first via `app.injector.instanceOf[Database].withTransaction { implicit conn => DocumentDAO.create(...) }`, with no ProcessDocument job. Then call the new signature.
   - `repositories/BankStatementRepositorySpec` "createConfirmedStatement" helper: create the document with `createDocument(userId, sha256 = random, kind = DocumentKind.BankStatementPdf)` (status Ingested) before confirming.
   - Add a repo test that after confirm the document status is Parsed and the user still has exactly one document.
4. Controller tests in `BankStatementDraftControllerSpec` confirm section:
   - Confirming a seeded ready draft leaves exactly one document for the user, with the seeded id and status Parsed.
   - The created statement's document_id equals the draft's document_id.
   - Existing assertions (rows, metadata, extraction info, suggestions job, draft removed, reconcile/metadata rejections) still pass unchanged.
   - Add a full flow: upload via API, seed or mark the draft ready via `BankStatementDraftDAO.markReady`, confirm. It ends with one Parsed document, the same id as created at upload.
5. Verify: `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, then `sbt "testOnly *BankStatementDraftControllerSpec *BankStatementRepositorySpec *BankStatementsControllerSpec"`.

tasks.title: Lock in ProcessDocument skip for BankStatementPdf documents
tasks.description:
Statement documents now exist with status Ingested before confirm, so the ProcessDocument guard matters more.

1. In `server/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/actions/documents/ProcessDocumentAction.scala`, update the stale comment on the `DocumentKind.BankStatementPdf` case. It says statements are "already Parsed on confirm"; they are now created as Ingested at upload and imported via the AI draft flow, so they must never go to Textract. Keep the logic unchanged.
2. Add `server/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/actions/documents/ProcessDocumentActionSpec.scala`, following the Mockito-stub style of `ParseReceiptActionSpec` (AnyWordSpec + Matchers + ScalaFutures + MockitoSugar).
   - Stub `DocumentsRepository.findById` to return a BankStatementPdf document with status Ingested.
   - Run the action.
   - Assert it completes and that `TextractClient`, `TextractJobRepository`, `TextractCacheRepository` and `BackgroundJobsRepository` have no interactions (`verifyNoInteractions`), and `documentsRepository.updateStatus` is never called.
   - Use subject names without the class name (RULE-TE-001), e.g. `"apply" should { "skip Textract for a bank statement document" ... }`.
   - Optionally add a contrast case: a Receipt-kind document with a cache hit does call updateStatus/enqueue.
3. Verify: `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, then `sbt "testOnly *ProcessDocumentActionSpec"`.

resultJson.brief:
LAYOUT (server, Scala 3, Play + Anorm):
- server/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/actions/bankstatements/: thin action classes (@Inject, implicit ec: ExecutionContext, clock: Clock), written as Future for-comprehensions that throw RuntimeException with user-facing messages (handleRequest turns these into an error response).
- repositories/*Repository.scala: each method is `Future { database.withConnection|withTransaction { implicit conn => DAO... } }`. Never compose Futures inside a repository (RULE-BE-005). Repositories own atomicity (RULE-BE-006).
- repositories/daos/*DAO.scala: raw Anorm SQL with string interpolation and `::UUID` casts (`${id.toString}::UUID`).
- repositories/models/*.scala: case classes.
- Evolutions: server/src/main/resources/evolutions/default/{1..6}.sql. Next is 7.sql. Ups-only (`-- !Ups` header), at most one evolution file per PR.

KEY FILES:
- actions/bankstatements/CreateBankStatementDraftAction.scala
  - `apply(userId: UUID, bytes: Array[Byte], filename: String): Future[ApiDraft.Data]`.
  - Computes sha256, then: draft dedup (`bankStatementDraftRepository.listByUser(userId)` sha match → "This file is already in your import queue"); `documentsRepository.findBySha256(userId, sha256)` → if Some, `bankStatementRepository.findByDocumentIdInternal(doc.id)` Some → "This statement was already imported".
  - storageKey = s"data/$userId/${LocalDate.now(clock)}/$sha256"; blobStorage.exists/put; draftId = UuidCreator.getTimeOrderedEpoch().
  - Builds `BackgroundJobData.Create(type = BackgroundJobType.ExtractBankStatementDraft, payload = BackgroundJobPayload.ExtractBankStatementDraft(draftId), status = Pending, executeAt/createdAt/updatedAt = now)`, then `bankStatementDraftRepository.create(draft, job)`.
- actions/bankstatements/ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction.scala
  - Ctor: (bankStatementDraftRepository, bankStatementRepository).
  - Today builds `Document.Create(..., kind = DocumentKind.BankStatementPdf, status = DocumentStatus.Parsed)` from draft.sha256/storageKey/filename and calls `bankStatementRepository.createConfirmedStatement(document, stmt, metadata, rows, extractionInfo, job)`, then `bankStatementDraftRepository.delete(draftId, userId)` (outside that transaction; leave as is).
  - Already uses Chimney (`io.scalaland.chimney.dsl.*`).
- actions/bankstatements/DiscardBankStatementDraftAction.scala: deletes only the draft. After this epic the document stays behind (Ingested), which is why re-upload must reuse it. Do not change discard.
- actions/documents/ProcessDocumentAction.scala: `apply(documentId)` → findById → terminal statuses (Parsed/ParseFailed/Unsupported) skipped → `process(doc)` matches `DocumentKind.BankStatementPdf => log + Future.unit`, else Textract path. Ctor: (DocumentsRepository, TextractCacheRepository, TextractJobRepository, BackgroundJobsRepository, TextractClient)(ec, clock).
- repositories/BankStatementDraftRepository.scala: `(database: Database)(implicit ec: DatabaseExecutionContext)`. Methods: listByUser, findByIdForUser, findById (internal, for the job), create(draft, job) [withTransaction], markReady, markFailed, updatePayload, delete.
- repositories/daos/BankStatementDraftDAO.scala:
  - Hand-written `RowParser` (`get[UUID]("id") ~ ... .map { case ... => BankStatementDraft(...) }`).
  - `selectColumns` string: "id, user_id, sha256, filename, storage_key, status, error, payload::TEXT AS payload, created_at, updated_at".
  - `create` INSERT lists the columns explicitly; status = BankStatementDraft.Status.Processing.
- repositories/models/BankStatementDraft.scala: `case class BankStatementDraft(id, userId, sha256, filename, storageKey, status: String, error, payload, createdAt, updatedAt)` and `Create(id, userId, sha256, filename, storageKey, createdAt, updatedAt)`. Status is a string-constants object; leave it.
- repositories/DocumentsRepository.scala: `(database)(implicit ec: DatabaseExecutionContext, clock: Clock)`.
  - `create(document, job)` always enqueues a job (used for receipts → ProcessDocument), so do NOT use it for statements.
  - `find(id, userId)` is user-scoped. `findById(id)` is internal. `findBySha256(userId, sha256)`. `updateStatus(id, status: DocumentStatus, parserVersion: Option[String])` (withConnection, uses clock).
- repositories/daos/DocumentDAO.scala:
  - `create(Document.Create)(implicit conn)`.
  - `updateStatus(id, status, parserVersion, updatedAt)(implicit conn)` throws "Document not found" if 0 rows; it also overwrites parser_version, so pass None.
  - `findBySha256`, `find`, `findById`, `delete(id, userId)`.
- repositories/models/Document.scala:
  - `Document(id, userId, sha256, storageKey, kind: DocumentKind, filename, status: DocumentStatus, parserVersion: Option[String], createdAt, updatedAt)`.
  - `Document.Create(id, userId, sha256, storageKey, kind, filename, status, createdAt, updatedAt)`.
- models/documents/DocumentKind.scala (enumeratum; BankStatementPdf entryName "bank_statement_pdf", Receipt, ...) and DocumentStatus (Ingested, Processing, Analyzed, Parsed, ParseFailed, Unsupported).
- repositories/BankStatementRepository.scala:
  - `(database)(implicit ec: DatabaseExecutionContext)` — NO clock.
  - `createConfirmedStatement(document, stmt: BankStatement.Create, metadata: BankStatement.Metadata, rows: List[BankStatementRow.Create], extractionInfo: Option[ExtractionInfo], job): Future[UUID]` does DocumentDAO.create + BankStatementDAO.create + BankStatementRowDAO.createAll + BackgroundJobDAO.create in one transaction.
  - `BankStatement.Create(id, documentId, userId, createdAt, updatedAt)`.
  - `findByDocumentIdInternal(documentId)`.
- repositories/ReceiptRepository.createWithDocument(document, receipt, job): the reference pattern (document + child + job in one transaction).
- controllers/BankStatementsController.scala: the controller logs the entry and resolves userId, then calls the action. Actions log the outcome with ids (include userId).

SCHEMA FACTS (3.sql):
- `document` has `CONSTRAINT document_user_sha256_unique UNIQUE (user_id, sha256)`, so you can never insert a second document with the same (user, sha256). This is why re-upload after discard must reuse the doc.
- bank_statement.document_id is UNIQUE, FK ON DELETE CASCADE.
- bank_statement_draft has no document_id today; its FK is named `bank_statement_draft_user_id_fk` (ON DELETE CASCADE).
- data-infra.md: FK name pattern `{table}_{reftable}_fk`; every FK column needs `CREATE INDEX {table}_{col}_index ... USING BTREE`; no CHECK; no DEFAULT; TEXT not VARCHAR; list queries need ORDER BY with an id tiebreaker; writes in withTransaction; user-owned queries need `WHERE user_id`. The exception is internal pipeline methods named *Internal or only called by jobs.

TESTS (docs/guide/testing.md):
- Repository specs extend `net.wiringbits.core.RepositorySpec` (testcontainers Postgres, evolutions applied) and use `withRepositories() { implicit repositories => ... }` plus helpers from `utils/RepositoryUtils` (`createUser()`, `createDocument(userId, sha256=, storageKey=, kind=, filename=, status=)` — note it also enqueues a ProcessDocument job — `createBankStatement`, `sampleStatementMetadata`).
- `RepositoryComponents` (core/RepositoryComponents.scala) currently has NO bankStatementDrafts field. Add it and construct it in RepositorySpec.withRepositories as `new BankStatementDraftRepository(db)(using Executors.databaseEC)`.
- Controller specs extend `controllers.common.PlayPostgresSpec` (full Play app with the live background executor) with `withApiClient { implicit client => ... }`, `createVerifyLoginUser(tokenGenerator).futureValue.id`, and `app.injector.instanceOf[Database]` for direct DAO seeding or raw SQL assertions; BankStatementDraftControllerSpec already does this for background_jobs counts.
- `BankStatementDraftControllerSpec.seedReadyDraftJson` inserts drafts via `BankStatementDraftDAO.create(DraftRecord.Create(...))` plus markReady. It must create a document first once the column is NOT NULL.
- `PlayPostgresSpec.createBankStatementWithRows` calls createConfirmedStatement with a Document.Create; it is used by many controller specs (BankStatementsControllerSpec, RefundsControllerSpec, DocumentsControllerSpec, McpControllerSpec), so keep its external signature.
- ApiClient methods: createBankStatementDraft(bytes, filename), listBankStatementDrafts, getBankStatementDraft(id), confirmBankStatementDraft(id).bankStatementId, discardBankStatementDraft(id), getBankStatement(id).
- Uploads use `NoOpBlobStorage`.
- Action specs are rare; ParseReceiptActionSpec shows the accepted Mockito-stub style for an action unit spec.
- Test naming: `"method or behaviour" should { "..." in ... }`, never repeating the class name.
- Use `.futureValue`; `-Werror` under CI=true, so remove unused imports.

CONVENTIONS:
- Chimney (`import io.scalaland.chimney.dsl.*`, `a.into[B].withFieldConst(_.x, v).transform`) for case-class→case-class mapping with 2+ shared fields.
- IDs via `UuidCreator.getTimeOrderedEpoch()`; timestamps via `clock.instant()`.
- Enums (DocumentKind/DocumentStatus), not strings.
- Never drop a Future (bind with `_ <-`).
- No dependency changes (build.sbt/plugins.sbt/package.json); revert any yarn.lock churn.
- Do not touch `ai_*` columns or classification code, the web/ frontend, or the parser_version/status cleanup.
- Commits/PR: no claude.ai links or Claude-Session trailers; `Co-Authored-By: Claude` is fine.
- Verify per task with `CI=true sbt Test/compile` and targeted `sbt "testOnly *XSpec"` (Docker needed for Postgres specs). The full `sbt test` runs only at the final stage.
